data.title: Education Minister Witnesses Signing of Nine Agreements with Leading US Universities and Companies
data.content:
Washington, November 20, 2026, SPA -- During his official visit to the United States, Minister of Education Yousef Al-Benyan witnessed the signing of nine bilateral cooperation agreements between Saudi educational entities and American universities, institutions, and companies.
    Focused on educational technologies, curricula, and digital content, these agreements aim to develop educational tools and resources, leverage international expertise, and enhance educational quality and outcomes.
    The agreements include a partnership between the Council of Universities' Affairs and Gallaudet University—an institution specializing in the education of students with hearing impairments—covering the development of academic and specialized programs, joint scientific research and studies, professional development, and the exchange of expertise.
    The minister also witnessed the signing of an agreement between Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University and the Educational Testing Service (ETS), alongside agreements between Maarif Education and both Google and National Geographic; between Tatweer Educational Technologies (TETCO) and both Google and Cisco; and between Tatweer Company for Educational Services and Savvas, McGraw Hill, and National Geographic to develop curricula and educational content.
    Spanning specialized education, assessment and evaluation, modern technology integration, digital solutions, and curriculum enrichment, these partnerships leverage global expertise to advance educational platforms and foster international technical collaboration. They align with the Ministry of Education's strategic direction to accelerate digital transformation across the education ecosystem and expand the use of innovation to elevate educational practices.
    -- SPA
